newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Paraguay to issue local bonds for $28 mln.
newsitem.headline: Paraguay to issue local bonds for $28 mln.

text.p: Paraguay will issue bonds on its local debt market for the equivalent of about $28 million either Friday or next week, the Central Bank said Thursday.

The two-year bond placement will be the first tranche of a $141 million program to help meet the government's financing needs for 1996 and part of 1997. They will pay interest of 16.5 percent in the local guarani currency and 8.25 percent in dollars.
Foreign banks are keenest to acquire the bonds, but local banks have also shown interest, the Central Bank said.
The remaining $113 million of the program will be placed next year.
The funds raised will be used to finance public investment, municipal spending and to assist farmers.
